{{/* customers.html — /customers index page. Composes components.* per Spec 17. NO inline styles. Page body is mounted via the components.shell partial using the unique customers.body template slot. */}} {{ define "customers.body" }} {{ if .LoadError }} {{ template "components.empty_state" (dict "Icon" "⚠️" "Title" "Customer registry unavailable" "Message" .LoadError) }} {{ else }} {{ template "components.section" (dict "Title" "Customers" "Subtitle" "Operator view of every customer account + their services. Drill into a card to see their devstation, bundles, identity, secrets, observability, and network posture.") }} {{ $cards := list }} {{ range .Customers }} {{ $cards = append $cards (dict "Icon" "👤" "Title" .DisplayName "Subtitle" (printf "%s · %d services · %d active" .BrandFront .ServiceCount .ActiveCount) "TierBadges" (list .Tier) "DrillHref" (printf "/customers/%s" .AccountSlug) "Metrics" (list (dict "Label" "ACTIVE" "Value" (toString .ActiveCount)) (dict "Label" "EXPIRING" "Value" (toString .ExpiringCount)) (dict "Label" "EXPIRED" "Value" (toString .ExpiredCount)))) }} {{ end }} {{ template "components.entity_list" (dict "Cards" $cards "Layout" "grid" "Empty" (dict "Icon" "🗂️" "Title" "No customers yet" "Message" "Drop a registry/customer-services/.services.yaml file and reload.")) }} {{ end }} {{ end }} {{ template "components.shell" . }}
